<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the molecule contains an aromatic ring (signals at 143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm) and a carbonyl group (signal at 167.15 ppm) together with aliphatic carbons (two CH₂ at 34.53 ppm and three methyls around 20 ppm). The logical way to split the structure is into an aromatic fragment and an aliphatic carbonyl fragment that could be joined by an ester linkage. The corresponding SMILES strings for these fragments are:

- Aromatic fragment: c1ccccc1  
- Aliphatic carbonyl fragment (acetate‑like): CC(=O)O

These two fragments can be connected (e.g., as an ester) to give the full molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'CC(=O)O']</final_answer>
